messages:
sara: Heads-up: planning a quick schema patch for subscriptions.subs_meta in the midnight window (00:30-02:30 UTC). Plan: pin web-api to v4.0.1 and run a small backfill to populate tenant_region.

devon: ACK. Table size? locks expected?

sara: ~4.5M rows. ALTER ADD COLUMN is instant. Backfill uses id-ordered updates in batches of 3k. Expect transient row-level locks only.

rahul: Suggested backfill params: BATCH_ROWS=3000, SLEEP_MS=300. Limit max concurrent workers to 6. Add a safepoint after every 50k rows to run validation.

deploy-bot: scheduled by @sara: migration-job v2026-06-16 queued. canary starting on 2 workers, sample=6k.

sara: Escalation plan: pause backfill -> revert routing -> if data issues, restore db snapshot rds-prod-snap-2026-06-16-0000.

sre-oncall: I'll watch lock_monitor and autokill long queries >4m after a 1-min warning. If lock_wait median >40ms for 3 minutes, hit holdpoint.

devon: Please add a quick sql check after each batch:
SELECT count(*) FROM subscriptions.subs_meta WHERE tenant_region IS NULL AND status='active';

sara: added auto-pause flag --auto-pause-on-errors=2 to deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: canary done: 6k rows processed, 0 violations, avg batch latency 120ms. canary OK.

sara: rolling to 30% workers. posting release note: "subscriptions migration: tenant_region added/backfilled. pin web-api v4.0.1 during window."

devon: include snapshot + revert command in release note.

sara: Added: "snapshot: rds-prod-snap-2026-06-16-0000; revert: rds-restore --from rds-prod-snap-2026-06-16-0000"

sre-oncall: small blip in lock_waits for ~20s but below threshold. monitoring.

sara: update: at 30% -> proceeding to 60%. will post when complete. :thumbsup:
